description: This bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) scores for three different LLaMA model sizes—LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B—under four distinct training conditions, as indicated by the legend: “no SFT” (solid blue-gray), “+ SFT on D₀” (solid tan), “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (solid purple-gray), and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (solid reddish-brown). The vertical axis represents the CoLeG-R (%) score, ranging from 0 to 80 in increments of 10, with a linear scale. The horizontal axis lists the three model sizes in order from left to right. For each model size, four bars are grouped together, each corresponding to one of the training conditions. The “no SFT” condition consistently yields the lowest scores across all models, ranging from approximately 67% for LLaMA-2-7B to 71% for LLaMA-2-13B. The “+ SFT on D₀” condition shows a moderate improvement, with scores around 67% to 70%. The “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” condition yields the highest scores for each model, reaching approximately 81% for LLaMA-2-7B, 83% for LLaMA-2-13B, and 82% for LLaMA-2-70B. The “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” condition shows scores very close to the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” condition, with values of approximately 82% for LLaMA-2-7B, 80% for LLaMA-2-13B, and 82% for LLaMA-2-70B. The bars are not sorted by value, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and pattern.
